title: Cocycle for normalized derived scalar extension comparisons
statement: For three composable coefficient ring maps, the normalized derived scalar extension comparisons defined by adicFiniteExtensionComp satisfy the associativity cocycle on every derived object.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 09C2, normalized ordinary tensor balancing

proof.text: Evaluate both composites on a K-flat resolution and use adicFiniteExtendCompFormula for each comparison; both ordinary tensor maps are the same reassociation.
Descend the equality through the derived localization and use naturality to obtain equality at every object.

mathlib_searches.query: associativity cocycle for composition isomorphisms of derived scalar extension
mathlib_searches.results: Only ordinary functor associativity; no normalized derived scalar extension cocycle found.
Ordinary naturality and associativity lemmas, but no declaration matching the normalized adic comparison.
No existing adic cocycle declaration in Mathlib or Sheaf; this node supplies the missing coherence statement.

lean.statement: theorem adicFiniteExtensionComp_cocycle {D : Type w} [SmallCategory D] (T : GrothendieckTopology D) {A B C E : Type w} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing E] (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C) (h : C →+* E) {fg : A →+* C} (efg : fg = g.comp f) {gh : B →+* E} (egh : gh = h.comp g) {k : A →+* E} (ek₁ : k = h.comp fg) (ek₂ : k = gh.comp f) (N : ConstantCompletion.D (constant T A)) : (adicFiniteExtension T h).map ((adicFiniteExtensionComp T f g fg efg).app N).hom ≫ ((adicFiniteExtensionComp T fg h k ek₁).app N).hom = ((adicFiniteExtensionComp T g h gh egh).app ((adicFiniteExtension T f).obj N)).hom ≫ ((adicFiniteExtensionComp T f gh k ek₂).app N).hom
